children: IX Acquisition Corp. reported a swing to profitability in the second quarter of 2026, posting net income of $919774 or diluted EPS of $0.14, compared with a net loss of $(516,153) and diluted loss per share of $(0.07) in the year‑ago quarter. The company had no operating revenues for the periods and generated non‑operating income largely from trust interest and fair‑value changes on warrant liabilities.
Net income was $919,774 for Q2 2026, versus a net loss of $(516,153) in Q2 2025 — a swing to profit driven by fair‑value gains on warrant liabilities.
Diluted EPS was $0.14 for Q2 2026, versus $(0.07) in Q2 2025.
Revenue: Not reported for the periods (no operating revenues; company generated non‑operating income from trust interest and fair‑value changes).
Business combination progress: Executed a merger agreement with AERKOMM and multiple amendments; re‑domiciled via merger to AKOM Inc. to facilitate closing.
Capital raising: Secured PIPE subscriptions of $35M and SAFE commitments totaling $13M to fund the merger and provide working capital.
Operational funding support: AERKOMM provided ongoing working capital support recognized monthly at $130K per month, with $425K due from AERKOMM as of June 30, 2026.
Trust account and timeline: $9.1M is held in the trust for the combination; the company extended the combination period through multiple amendments to October 2026.
Market and listing status: Following Nasdaq delisting, trading migrated to the OTC Markets while the combined entity pursues de‑SPAC listing requirements.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
